description: Scrape and extract public data from 27+ social media platforms using the ScrapeCreators REST API. Covers TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Snapchat, Twitch, Kick, Truth Social, TikTok Shop, Google, and link-in-bio services (Linktree, Komi, Pillar, Linkbio, Linkme, Amazon Shop). Use when the user asks to scrape, fetch, extract, search, or look up social media profiles, posts, videos, reels, comments, transcripts, followers, ads, hashtags, trending content, or engagement metrics from any social platform. Also use when user mentions ScrapeCreators, social media API, ad library, or creator data.
